fact: CEGA and Togo's Ministry of Public Service Efficiency and Digital Transformation announced a new Data Ambassadors Program under the Togo Data Lab to train 27 data specialists in government, and expect to train 70 government data scientists in the first two years.

A GIZ ProDigiT LinkedIn post says the Ministry-initiated Digital Ambassadors programme run by Agence Togo Digital graduated 80 civil servants placed in 27 ministries and agencies after 14 months, and that a programme to train 20,000 civil servants in basic digital skills is to launch in the coming months.
system: Programme des Ambassadeurs et Ambassadrices du Digital

fact: Togo's Ministry of Public Service Efficiency and Digital Transformation, with GIZ and Simplon, started a six-week data science certification course at the Togo Data Lab on 14 April 2026 for public administration professionals, aiming at 60 civil servants among 260 trainees.
system: Programme certifiant en Data Science (Togo Data Lab, Simplon)

fact: Togo First reports that the four-week digitisation of the Foreign Affairs Ministry, launched on 31 March 2026 under the Public Administration Digitalization Program, includes training over 280 civil servants in cybersecurity practices and digital tools.
The LuxDev project sheet for ProDigiT says 16 public executives were supported and that structured data science and digital skills pathways for the administration are in preparation.
